summary: Backend testing complete - All 41 tests passed (24 existing + 17 new league features). Comprehensive testing of new user fields (preferred_position, wins, draws, losses, league_points), match types (friendly/league), 3-team matches, league points system, and all CRUD operations.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ All new user fields (preferred_position, wins, draws, losses, league_points) properly initialized to 0/None on registration
✅ match_type defaults to 'friendly', third_team_enabled defaults to false
✅ League points formula correct: win=3, draw=1, loss=0
✅ League points ONLY awarded for 2-team league matches (third_team_enabled=false)
✅ 3-team matches do NOT award league points (even if match_type='league')
✅ Lineup generation with third_team_enabled=true correctly distributes players across 3 teams using snake draft
✅ Lineup generation with third_team_enabled=false produces empty team_c array
✅ Result recording accepts team_c_score when third_team_enabled=true
✅ matches_played incremented for all participants in 3-team matches
✅ Editing league match result correctly reverts prior league points before applying new
✅ Deleting league match correctly reverts league points for all participants
✅ All MongoDB _id properly excluded from responses
✅ All existing tests still pass (no regressions)
seed_data_creation: Tests create unique users per test run using timestamp-based email addresses (TEST_*_{timestamp}@clubdodo.com). Admin user (admin@clubdodo.com / dodo2026) is seeded on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints tested and working correctly. New features verified: preferred_position field (GK/DEF/MID/FWD/ANY), league points system (win=3, draw=1, loss=0), 3-team matches with team_c, match_type (friendly/league). League points ONLY awarded for 2-team league matches. 3-team matches increment matches_played but do NOT award league points. Result editing and match deletion correctly revert league points. All existing functionality still working (no regressions).

auth: POST /api/auth/register - accepts preferred_position (GK/DEF/MID/FWD/ANY) and persists it
POST /api/auth/register - without preferred_position defaults to None
POST /api/auth/login - admin login returns admin role
GET /api/auth/me - with Bearer token returns user with new fields (preferred_position, wins, draws, losses, league_points)
users: GET /api/users - lists users sorted by rating desc
PUT /api/users/me - updates name, shirt_number, profile_picture, preferred_position
config: PUT /api/config - admin only, updates club_name and club_logo
matches: POST /api/matches - any authenticated user can create
POST /api/matches - accepts match_type ('friendly'|'league') and third_team_enabled (bool)
POST /api/matches - defaults to match_type='friendly' and third_team_enabled=false
GET /api/matches - lists all matches
GET /api/matches/{id} - returns match with votes array and new fields (match_type, third_team_enabled)
POST /api/matches/{id}/vote - stores vote, overwrites previous
POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup - editor only, snake draft by rating
POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup - with third_team_enabled=true produces team_a, team_b, team_c
POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup - with third_team_enabled=false produces empty team_c array
POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup - non-editor returns 403
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - editor only, updates stats and rating
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - with match_type='league' awards league points (winner +3, loser 0, draw +1 each)
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - with match_type='friendly' does NOT award league points
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - accepts team_c_score when third_team_enabled=true
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - 3-team match increments matches_played for all 3 teams
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - 3-team match does NOT award league points (even if match_type='league')
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - editing reverts prior stats and league points
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - non-editor returns 403
DELETE /api/matches/{id} - editor only, reverts stats and league points
DELETE /api/matches/{id} - non-editor returns 403
